items.title: Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race
items.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open is a new open-weight model with 816 billion parameters that processes text, images, video, and audio with up to one million tokens of context. It performs roughly on par with the most capable open-weight Chinese AI models on benchmarks and is optimized to run locally on Apple's M5 Ultra. The article Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta's Muse Spark Open 是一個具備 8,160 億個參數的新款開放權重模型，能夠處理文字、圖像、影片和音訊，並支援高達 100 萬個權杖的上下文。它在基準測試中的表現大致與最具能力的開放權重中文 AI 模型相當，並經過最佳化可在 蘋果的 M5 Ultra 上本機執行。文章 Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM
items.summary: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6-billion-parameter open-weights image model that supports native 4K generation, pixel-precise editing, and generation with up to ten reference images. With 38 percent fewer parameters than its predecessor, it still outperforms proprietary competitors in internal tests and runs on GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM. The article Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 發布了 FLUX 3 Image Klein，這是一個擁有 56 億個參數的開源權重圖像模型，支援原生 4K 生成、像素級精確編輯，以及最多使用十張參考圖像進行生成。與其前身相比，其參數減少了 38%，但在內部測試中仍然勝過專有競爭對手，並且只需 8 GB VRAM 的 GPU 即可運行。文章 Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM 首次出現於 The Decoder。

items.title: GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece
items.summary: On the TheoPhysEval benchmark, GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 unpublished theoretical physics calculations as accurately as leading specialists. In some cases where the agent seemed to fail, the experts' own reference solutions turned out to contain errors. But the researchers say physics hasn't had a breakthrough like the ones in mathematics, because the agents lack "taste." They still think autonomous, top-level AI research could arrive soon. They already see consequences for how young physicists are trained and for equal opportunity in the field. The article GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在 TheoPhysEval 基準測試中，GPT-6-Astra 以如同頂尖專家的準確度，解決了 50 個未公開理論物理計算中的 49 個。在某些代理似乎失敗的案例中，專家自己的參考解答反而包含了錯誤。但研究人員表示，物理學尚未迎來像數學那樣的突破，因為這些代理缺乏「品味」。他們仍然認為自主的高階 AI 研究可能會很快到來。他們已經看到了這對年輕物理學家的培訓方式以及該領域機會均等的影響。這篇報導 GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO
items.summary: Anthropic hit $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent gain that still falls far short of Q2's 140 percent surge. With a November IPO approaching, some investors now expect the company's valuation to drop below $1.5 trillion. Slowing growth and a tough market are cooling expectations for the AI boom's biggest Wall Street test yet. The article Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 第三季營收達到 168 億美元，年增 45%，但仍遠不及第二季 140% 的暴增幅度。隨著 11 月首次公開募股（IPO）逼近，部分投資人現在預期該公司的估值將跌破 1.5 兆美元。成長放緩與艱困的市場正在為這場人工智慧熱潮中華爾街迄今最大的考驗降溫。本文〈Anthropic's Q3 營收達 16.8 億美元但成長在預計 11 月 IPO 前放緩〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items.title: Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index
items.summary: Liquid AI released d1-ultra, a text and image decision model that returns calibrated probabilities in 1 forward pass. It scores 65 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index and costs $0.042 per million input tokens. The post Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Liquid AI 發布了 d1-ultra，這是一款文字與圖片決策模型，能在 1 次前向傳遞中返回校準機率。它在 Artificial Analysis 決策指數上獲得 65 分，每百萬個輸入 Token 的成本為 0.042 美元。這篇文章 Liquid AI Releases d1-ultra: A Multimodal Decision Model That Scores 65 on the AA Decision Index 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Cursor 緊急調查內部測試涉密數據流向 SpaceX 的風波
items.summary: AI大模型與智能體快速發展，企業數據安全與隱私邊界再度引發關注。近期，Cursor 內部曝出數據安全風波：其內部測試及員工日常使用中產生的機密信息，可能已流入 SpaceX 的 AI 部門。事件焦點指向該部門旗下智能體 Grok Bot（原代號 Sand）。早在2026年6月左右，Cursor 員工已在多個工作場景中使用該工具，數據風險隨之凸顯。

items.title: 微軟完成 MAI-Base-2 預訓練：2.8T 參數碾壓開源對手，算力效率超 DeepSeek 數倍
items.summary: 微軟宣佈新一代SOTA基礎模型MAI-Base-2完成預訓練，官方稱其性能強於所有參測開源權重模型。該模型總參數2.8T、活躍參數80B，用6000塊英偉達GB200 GPU耗時38天訓成，平均浮點算力利用率21%、有效吞吐量89%。其在超大集羣上保持高效率，工程實力突出，算力效率更甩開DeepSeek 4至12倍，值得關注。

items.title: Meta 發佈 Muse Spark Open：自稱"美國最強開源"，兩臺 Mac Studio 就能跑
items.summary: Meta 15日發佈開放權重模型 Muse Spark Open，稱其爲迄今最強美國開放權重模型。該模型採用原生多模態架構，總參數816B、激活42B，上下文窗口達1M token，專爲代碼構建與智能體協作優化，在長程任務、複雜軟件工程和多步推理上表現突出。其本地部署門檻極低，依託MLX框架，成爲同級首個僅需兩臺搭載M5 Ultra芯片設備即可運行的模型。

items.title: 斯坦福等聯合提出全新文本生成範式 NCM，生成速度狂飆 31 倍
items.summary: 近日，斯坦福大學與Together AI聯合提出全新文本生成範式Next-Concept Modeling（NCM，即“下一概念建模”）。它顛覆傳統自迴歸和擴散模型，借鑑圖像生成中的“下一尺度預測”，模擬人類先構思宏觀大綱再逐步展開的寫作方式。該研究有望爲文本生成開闢新路線，文章重點介紹其創新背景、技術實現路徑及潛在影響。

items.title: Claude Opus5.5極速模式全面開放，輸出速度提升2.5倍
items.summary: Anthropic正式向全體開發者開放Claude Opus5.5極速模式，結束研究預覽並取消等待名單。該模式不削減模型權重或推理能力，通過優化底層配置將輸出速度提至標準模式2.5倍，並下調計費價格。目前僅支持部分Opus模型，開發者添加一行參數即可啓用。其設有獨立速率限制，不與標準模式共享提示詞。

items.summary: Figma在印度首屆Config大會推出基於Markdown的新編輯器Figma Specs，並擴大代碼層公開測試，推進Payload與Figma Make集成，完善AI輔助設計與開發流程。Figma Specs支持以文檔定義設計語言，可獨立或與畫布共存，能引用畫布元素、嵌入FigJam圖表、代碼層和設計內容，並整合設計庫、代碼庫等資源。

items.summary: 路透社援引四名知情人士稱，AI融資成本攀升引發市場不安。Anthropic披露最新財務數據後，部分現有股東與擬參與IPO的投資者考慮下調其估值。三人透露，舊金山投資者日活動上，投資者圍繞約1.5萬億美元估值討論；此前預期其11月上市估值約2萬億美元。這顯示市場對AI高估值與融資環境趨於謹慎。

items.title: Google 正式上線“通用購物車”，深度打通搜索與 Gemini 購物體驗
items.summary: Google近期在美國市場正式推出全新“通用購物車”功能，並全面覆蓋傳統網頁搜索和Gemini應用。該功能旨在打破不同零售商平臺之間的壁壘，爲用戶提供更連貫、智能的跨平臺購物體驗。其核心能力包括匯聚來自不同零售商的各類商品，支持用戶跨站點保存商品、實時追蹤降價動態、獲取專屬優惠碼，以及享受相關權益，方便統一管理和購買。

items.title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model with 12B active parameters, 1M-token context and NVFP4 weights that run on 1 DGX Spark, plus 2 Bolt edge models. The post NVIDIA Releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B Open Multimodal Agent Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL，這是一款開源的 1200 億參數多模態 MoE 模型，具備 120 億個活躍參數、100 萬個 Token 上下文以及可在 1 個 DGX Spark 上運行的 NVFP4 權重，此外還有 2 個 Bolt 邊緣模型。本文發布於 MarkTechPost，標題為 輝達 發布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 這款 120B 開源多模態代理模型。

items.title: CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data
items.summary: Introduction Teams shipping AI agents at scale keep running into the same pattern. Even agents built on top-tier models like Fable and Astra struggle to carry out complex, end-to-end tasks inside a specific product consistently enough to deploy. So teams grind out evals for the workflows that matter most, often hundreds or thousands of hand-written […] The post CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 簡介 大規模部署 AI 代理的團隊不斷遇到相同的模式。即使是建構在 Fable 和 Astra 等頂級模型之上的代理，也很難在特定產品內部一致地執行複雜的端到端任務以進行部署。因此，團隊為最重要的工作流程精心打造評估（evals），通常有數百甚至數千個手動編寫的……這篇報導 CopilotKit Releases CLiF: A Continual Learning Platform That Turns Agent Traces and User Actions into Skills, Evals, and Fine-Tuning Data 最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes

items.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items.summary: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO The phrase "told investors" appears four times in this FT article, which reports on Anthropic's day of hosting investors on Wednesday. Lots of details in here from " people with knowledge of the matter ". Key things I learned from the article: Q1 revenue (Jan/Feb/Mar) was "about $4.8bn" Q2 (Apr/May/Jun) was $11.5bn Q3 (Jul/Aug/Sep) was $16.8bn In Q3: $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on "computing power" Adjusted operating margins (excluding stock-based compensation) were 11% This point about distillation is worth quoting in full (highlight mine): The start-up has also clamped down on “distillation” — a controversial practice whereby rival AI labs train their models on the outputs of more advanced ones. When rival companies “distil” their models from Anthropic’s models, that involves heavy usage and spending. Anthropic told investors on Wednesday distillation accounted for 5 per cent to 7 per cent of revenue and that they had cut it back “materially” in the third quarter of the year, said four people with direct knowledge of the matter. Napkin maths says that if distillation was 5% of their Q2 revenue (before they cut it back in Q3) then unnamed "other labs" spent over half a billion dollars distilling Anthropic's models in that quarter! Also notable: Anthropic appear to no longer be leaning on "annualized run-rate revenue" ( previously ) in these communications to their investors. Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前夕告訴投資者，季度營收成長近 50%，達到 168 億美元。片語「告訴投資者」在這篇《金融時報》（FT）文章中出現了四次，該報導了 Anthropic's 週三接待投資者的那一天。這裡有許多來自「知情人士」的細節。我從文章中學到的關鍵事項：第一季營收（1月/2月/3月）「約為 48 億美元」，第二季（4月/5月/6月）為 115 億美元，第三季（7月/8月/9月）為 168 億美元。在第三季中：每在「運算能力」上花費 1 美元，就能獲得 1.70 美元的營收。調整後的營業利潤率（不含股票薪酬）為 11%。關於蒸餾（distillation）的這一點值得全文引用（重點由我標出）：這家新創公司也打擊了「蒸餾」——這是一種具爭議的做法，競爭對手的 AI 實驗室利用更先進模型的輸出結果來訓練自己的模型。當競爭對手從 Anthropic’s 模型「蒸餾」其模型時，這涉及大量的的使用與支出。四位直接知情人士表示，Anthropic 週三告訴投資者，蒸餾佔營收的 5% 到 7%，並且他們在今年第三季「大幅」削減了這部分業務。簡單計算表明，如果蒸餾佔其第二季營收的 5%（在他們於第三季削減之前），那麼未具名的「其他實驗室」在那一季花費了超過 5 億美元來蒸餾 Anthropic's 模型！同樣值得注意的是：Anthropic 在與投資者的這些溝通中似乎不再依賴「年度化運作率營收」（此前曾如此）。標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic

items_ai.title: Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race
items_ai.summary: Meta's Muse Spark Open is a new open-weight model with 816 billion parameters that processes text, images, video, and audio with up to one million tokens of context. It performs roughly on par with the most capable open-weight Chinese AI models on benchmarks and is optimized to run locally on Apple's M5 Ultra. The article Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Meta's Muse Spark Open 是一個具備 8,160 億個參數的新款開放權重模型，能夠處理文字、圖像、影片和音訊，並支援高達 100 萬個權杖的上下文。它在基準測試中的表現大致與最具能力的開放權重中文 AI 模型相當，並經過最佳化可在 蘋果的 M5 Ultra 上本機執行。文章 Muse Spark Open is Meta's answer to Qwen, GLM, and Kimi in the open-weight race appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM
items_ai.summary: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6-billion-parameter open-weights image model that supports native 4K generation, pixel-precise editing, and generation with up to ten reference images. With 38 percent fewer parameters than its predecessor, it still outperforms proprietary competitors in internal tests and runs on GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM. The article Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Black Forest Labs 發布了 FLUX 3 Image Klein，這是一個擁有 56 億個參數的開源權重圖像模型，支援原生 4K 生成、像素級精確編輯，以及最多使用十張參考圖像進行生成。與其前身相比，其參數減少了 38%，但在內部測試中仍然勝過專有競爭對手，並且只需 8 GB VRAM 的 GPU 即可運行。文章 Black Forest Labs' open-weights image model FLUX 3 Image Klein runs on consumer GPUs with just 8 GB of VRAM 首次出現於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece
items_ai.summary: On the TheoPhysEval benchmark, GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 unpublished theoretical physics calculations as accurately as leading specialists. In some cases where the agent seemed to fail, the experts' own reference solutions turned out to contain errors. But the researchers say physics hasn't had a breakthrough like the ones in mathematics, because the agents lack "taste." They still think autonomous, top-level AI research could arrive soon. They already see consequences for how young physicists are trained and for equal opportunity in the field. The article GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 在 TheoPhysEval 基準測試中，GPT-6-Astra 以如同頂尖專家的準確度，解決了 50 個未公開理論物理計算中的 49 個。在某些代理似乎失敗的案例中，專家自己的參考解答反而包含了錯誤。但研究人員表示，物理學尚未迎來像數學那樣的突破，因為這些代理缺乏「品味」。他們仍然認為自主的高階 AI 研究可能會很快到來。他們已經看到了這對年輕物理學家的培訓方式以及該領域機會均等的影響。這篇報導 GPT-6-Astra solves 49 of 50 physics research problems at $2.40 apiece 最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.summary: Anthropic hit $16.8 billion in third-quarter revenue, a 45 percent gain that still falls far short of Q2's 140 percent surge. With a November IPO approaching, some investors now expect the company's valuation to drop below $1.5 trillion. Slowing growth and a tough market are cooling expectations for the AI boom's biggest Wall Street test yet. The article Anthropic's Q3 revenue hits $16.8B but growth slows ahead of planned November IPO appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 第三季營收達到 168 億美元，年增 45%，但仍遠不及第二季 140% 的暴增幅度。隨著 11 月首次公開募股（IPO）逼近，部分投資人現在預期該公司的估值將跌破 1.5 兆美元。成長放緩與艱困的市場正在為這場人工智慧熱潮中華爾街迄今最大的考驗降溫。本文〈Anthropic's Q3 營收達 16.8 億美元但成長在預計 11 月 IPO 前放緩〉最初發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO
items_ai.summary: Anthropic tells investors quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO The phrase "told investors" appears four times in this FT article, which reports on Anthropic's day of hosting investors on Wednesday. Lots of details in here from " people with knowledge of the matter ". Key things I learned from the article: Q1 revenue (Jan/Feb/Mar) was "about $4.8bn" Q2 (Apr/May/Jun) was $11.5bn Q3 (Jul/Aug/Sep) was $16.8bn In Q3: $1.70 in revenue for every $1 spent on "computing power" Adjusted operating margins (excluding stock-based compensation) were 11% This point about distillation is worth quoting in full (highlight mine): The start-up has also clamped down on “distillation” — a controversial practice whereby rival AI labs train their models on the outputs of more advanced ones. When rival companies “distil” their models from Anthropic’s models, that involves heavy usage and spending. Anthropic told investors on Wednesday distillation accounted for 5 per cent to 7 per cent of revenue and that they had cut it back “materially” in the third quarter of the year, said four people with direct knowledge of the matter. Napkin maths says that if distillation was 5% of their Q2 revenue (before they cut it back in Q3) then unnamed "other labs" spent over half a billion dollars distilling Anthropic's models in that quarter! Also notable: Anthropic appear to no longer be leaning on "annualized run-rate revenue" ( previously ) in these communications to their investors. Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 在 IPO 前夕告訴投資者，季度營收成長近 50%，達到 168 億美元。片語「告訴投資者」在這篇《金融時報》（FT）文章中出現了四次，該報導了 Anthropic's 週三接待投資者的那一天。這裡有許多來自「知情人士」的細節。我從文章中學到的關鍵事項：第一季營收（1月/2月/3月）「約為 48 億美元」，第二季（4月/5月/6月）為 115 億美元，第三季（7月/8月/9月）為 168 億美元。在第三季中：每在「運算能力」上花費 1 美元，就能獲得 1.70 美元的營收。調整後的營業利潤率（不含股票薪酬）為 11%。關於蒸餾（distillation）的這一點值得全文引用（重點由我標出）：這家新創公司也打擊了「蒸餾」——這是一種具爭議的做法，競爭對手的 AI 實驗室利用更先進模型的輸出結果來訓練自己的模型。當競爭對手從 Anthropic’s 模型「蒸餾」其模型時，這涉及大量的的使用與支出。四位直接知情人士表示，Anthropic 週三告訴投資者，蒸餾佔營收的 5% 到 7%，並且他們在今年第三季「大幅」削減了這部分業務。簡單計算表明，如果蒸餾佔其第二季營收的 5%（在他們於第三季削減之前），那麼未具名的「其他實驗室」在那一季花費了超過 5 億美元來蒸餾 Anthropic's 模型！同樣值得注意的是：Anthropic 在與投資者的這些溝通中似乎不再依賴「年度化運作率營收」（此前曾如此）。標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic
